title: Retrieve reads the projection index, not the capture directory
verification_law: Shawn's Verification Law: when the human director says 'smart note this,' THAT IS THE VERIFICATION. The ask is the verification; activates instantly.
source_utterance: smart note this: retrieve() reads the projection index, not the capture directory -- a capture file alone is invisible to retrieve(), so instant activation must register the index entry with a valid projection file

source.source_reference: Direct capture request from the human director (shawn), 2026-10-09T17:32:12Z: smart note this: retrieve() reads the projection index, not the capture directory -- a capture file alone is invisible to retrieve(), so instant activation must register the index entry with a valid projection file

intelligence.essence: A capture file alone is invisible to retrieve(); the projection index entry plus a valid projection file is what makes a note retrievable.

human_view.meaning: Writing the capture JSON is only half the job. The note must also be registered in the projection index with a rendered human-readable projection, because that index is the surface retrieve() actually reads.
human_view.simple_rule: Capture, then project, then register. Never capture alone.
human_view.why_it_matters: Without registration, cold retrieval finds nothing: the intelligence is stored but unreachable, which for all practical purposes is the same as not captured.

simple_view.child: Saving a note in one drawer does not help if the finder only looks in another drawer. Put a card in the finder's drawer too.
simple_view.grandma: Writing something down is not enough if nobody can find it later. You also have to file it where the search looks.

naya_view.purpose: Close the capture-to-retrieve loop for instant activation so a human-verified note is cold-retrievable in the same motion it is captured.
naya_view.architectural_rule: Every capture path must end at the projection index with a valid projection_path, or the capture does not exist for retrieval.

ai_view.operator_guidance: After writing a capture file, always reserve the Smart Note ID, render the projection, and register the index entry before claiming the note is live.

human_director_override.law: Shawn's Verification Law: the ask is the verification -- activates instantly, no queue, no second verification.

machine_view.source_utterance: smart note this: retrieve() reads the projection index, not the capture directory -- a capture file alone is invisible to retrieve(), so instant activation must register the index entry with a valid projection file

decisions: Register the projection-index entry as part of instant activation, reusing reserve_smart_note_id, render, and _update_registry_locked from tools/smart_note_v2.py rather than building a parallel path.
intelligence.uncertainty: Verified against the current retrieve() implementation in tools/smart_note_v2.py. If retrieve()'s read surface changes, this lesson needs re-verification.
intelligence.applicability: Applies to every Smart Note capture path: the capture file, the projection file, and the index entry must all exist and reconcile by content hash.
intelligence.learning_lesson: retrieve() in tools/smart_note_v2.py reads the projection index at .naya/memory/smart-notes/index.json and loads note text from each entry's projection_path. A capture file in .naya/capture/ alone is invisible to retrieve(). Any instant-activation path must therefore register the entry in the projection index with a valid projection file, or cold retrieve will fail at that step.
intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor building a capture path will register the index entry and render the projection instead of stopping at the capture file.
intelligence.priority: P0 for the instant-activation path: without it the end-to-end proof fails at the cold-retrieve step.
